Afternoon floor staff,
Thanks for a crowded month; the welfare lead discussed a detail about arrival checks

Please keep the first contact calm and concise when you field companion-animal bookings for Aurelia Skyways. The most common issues we saw were missed document checks, unclear crate guidance, and rushed handoffs at the counter. When a traveler arrives with a pet, confirm the basic paperwork, repeat the carrier and welfare requirements in plain language, and note anything unusual before the file moves on. Clear guidance before departure reduces confusion later, and it gives the cabin team a better start once the animal is on board. 

For the desk itself, keep the workspace tidy, log any welfare concern without delay, and pass onward only the details that matter. If a traveler seems uncertain, slow the pace and restate the key points once. That small step prevents avoidable stress for the animal and for the customer. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, so our job is to avoid preventable gaps at handover and make sure the record is easy to follow. If you see a mismatch between the booking and the crate or pet details, stop the transfer and correct it before the next stage. 

We are still seeing good work from the team, and that standard should hold. Use the same steady approach on every shift, even when the queue is long and the questions repeat. Consistency at the Companion Animal Travel Desk is part of the safety review, not an extra task.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
